recommendation: Release safety: roll updates out to a small share of users first and stop the rollout when crash reports jump.
evidence: Version 1.12.0 (Feb 2026) brought ~1,200 one-star reviews in two weeks (~26x usual); 'app won't open' is in 51% of negative reviews.

recommendation: Make sign-up work without SMS problems: an in-app OTP option, clearer errors, and support for users abroad.
evidence: Sign-up / SMS verification is in 18% of negative reviews; 'not working from abroad' in 3%.

recommendation: When the security check blocks a phone, say which app or setting caused it.
evidence: Security-block and unsupported-phone complaints ('this app is hooked') are in 3% of negative reviews, and users say they can't tell what to remove.

recommendation: Stabilize the app before new features: test updates on more phone models and stage rollouts.
evidence: 'App won't open / crashes' rose from 26% to 39% of negative reviews in the last six months; version 6.9.0 had 65% one-star reviews.

recommendation: Show the status of every failed payment or ATM withdrawal in the app, with an automatic refund date.
evidence: Failed or stuck transactions are in 10% of Fawry's negative reviews (bill payments, recharges, Fawry card at ATMs), the highest of all five apps.

recommendation: Keep investing in customer service: it is improving but still the top complaint.
evidence: Customer service is in 34% of negative reviews overall, down from 29% to 17% in the last six months compared with the six before.

recommendation: Fix the card journey: delivery or pickup outside Cairo, delivery tracking, and clear card fees.
evidence: The card is the top complaint (25% of negative reviews): waiting time, branches, and the 99 EGP card fee.

recommendation: Answer negative reviews and support chats faster.
evidence: Telda replies to only 19% of negative reviews, and customer-service complaints rose from 21% to 26% in the last six months.

recommendation: Investigate why ratings are slipping before it becomes a trend.
evidence: Average rating fell from 4.09 to 3.72 and the 1-star share rose from 17% to 26% (last six months vs the six before).

recommendation: Tell applicants the reason for a rejection, and pre-check eligibility in the app before they travel to a branch.
evidence: Rejected applications or low limits are in 12% of negative reviews, often 'rejected after hours at a branch with no reason'.

recommendation: Set a reply target for complaints.
evidence: valU replies to 88% of negative reviews, but the median reply takes 46 days.

recommendation: Stop the decline: fix app stability and make fees and interest clear before purchase.
evidence: Average rating fell from 2.80 to 2.09 in the last six months; 'app won't open' rose from 10% to 23% of negative reviews; fees and interest 7%, fraud accusations 9%.

recommendation: Make the wallet page inside Ana Vodafone fast and reliable (loading, lag and crashes).
evidence: 'App won't open / crashes / slow' is in 47% of negative wallet reviews; 22% of 4-5★ wallet reviews still describe a problem.

recommendation: Review the wallet sign-up and verification steps.
evidence: Sign-up, login or verification problems are in 14% of negative wallet reviews. (Only six months and ~700 reviews of full coverage.)
